description:
Returns every offer group matching the onchain group id, regardless of lifecycle status. The maker is not required; optional chain_id and maker query parameters can disambiguate the lookup. Distinct chain, maker, and group-id combinations remain separate, and no match returns an empty data array.

The endpoint returns every latest offer revision in each matched group and exposes the current lifecycle as `status`. Each group exposes the shared offer intent as `type`, or `null` when its latest offers have inconsistent `buy` and `reduce_only` values. It does not apply Router mempool admission policy: oracle, token, market-triplet, LLTV, RCF threshold, and other mempool-validation policy checks do not gate retrieval.

Each nested offer includes the exact per-offer `ratifier_data` bytes originally submitted, plus `parsed_ratifier_data`, a structured view discriminated by `ratifier_type`. The type is identified by matching `ratifier` against the chain's known Midnight ratifier deployments: `rate_v1` exposes `rate_per_second_wad` and `allowed_taker`, `price_v1` exposes `allowed_taker` (the offer-level `tick` is the ratified price), and `ecrecover` and `setter` expose only their type. A zero `allowed_taker` means any taker may take the offer. An unrecognized ratifier address returns `unknown`; a recognized address whose `ratifier_data` cannot be decoded returns `invalid` with `expected_ratifier_type`.
name: morpho_midnight_get_offer_group

data.description: Offer groups in any lifecycle state matching the requested onchain group identifier.

callback.description: Verified group callback metadata, or null when the latest offer set is empty-callback, malformed, inconsistent, unregistered, registered to another owner, or registered after offer creation.

chain_id.description: Chain id where the group exists.

consumed.description: Latest consumed amount for this group.

created_at.description: Timestamp of the first matching status-targeted offer created in this group.

expiry.description: Maximum offer expiry derived from the group's latest offer set. Active and scheduled groups use the not-yet-ended horizon; terminal statuses use the complete latest set.

max_assets.description: Representative matching offer max assets for this group.

max_units.description: Representative matching offer max units for this group.

offers.description: Status-targeted latest offers matching the non-market request filters. Group-id lookup returns every latest offer revision regardless of status.

buy.description: Whether the offer is a buy offer.

continuous_fee_cap.description: Maximum continuous fee accepted by the maker.

market.description: Immutable market configuration used to derive market_id. This is included because market_id is a one-way hash and uncreated markets cannot be decoded from it.

collaterals.description: Collateral configuration used to derive the market id.

liquidation_cursor.description: Liquidation cursor for this collateral, WAD-scaled.

lltv.description: Liquidation loan-to-value for this collateral, WAD-scaled.

oracle.description: Oracle address used for this collateral.

maturity.description: Market maturity timestamp in unix seconds.

parsed_ratifier_data.description: Structured metadata decoded from ratifier_data. The ratifier type is identified by matching ratifier against the chain's known Midnight ratifier deployments; ratifier_data remains the authoritative raw bytes.

ratifier_data.description: Opaque per-offer ratifier data passed unchanged to Midnight take.

receiver_if_maker_is_seller.description: Receiver when the maker is the seller.

status.description: Current lifecycle status derived from every latest offer in the group.

type.description: Shared offer intent across the group's status-targeted offers, or null when their buy and reduce-only values are inconsistent.

ParsedRatifierDataInvalid.description: Ratifier address is a known deployment, but ratifier_data could not be decoded for its type.

expected_ratifier_type.description: Ratifier type identified from the ratifier address.

ParsedRatifierDataInvalid.title: Invalid

ParsedRatifierDataPriceV1.description: PriceRatifierV1 offer. The offer-level tick is the ratified price.

allowed_taker.description: Only taker allowed to take the offer. The zero address means any taker may take it.

ParsedRatifierDataPriceV1.title: PriceV1

allowed_taker.description: Only taker allowed to take the offer. The zero address means any taker may take it.

rate_per_second_wad.description: Per-second simple interest rate encoded in ratifier_data, WAD-scaled (1e18 = 100% per second).

ParsedRatifierDataUnknown.description: Ratifier address is not a known Midnight ratifier deployment.
ParsedRatifierDataUnknown.title: Unknown
